calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT 
  fiscal_year, 
  fiscal_period, 
  fiscal_period_label, 
  period_start_date, 
  period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year LIKE 'FY%'
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period
LIMIT 10

WITH fiscal_periods AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN fiscal_periods fp ON d.calendar_date >= fp.period_start_date 
                                AND d.calendar_date <= fp.period_end_date
  WHERE f.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY fp.fiscal_period
),
web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.web_order_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(f.order_total_gross) AS total_sales
  FROM fact_web_order f
  INNER JOIN fiscal_periods fp ON DATE(f.order_ts_utc) >= fp.period_start_date 
                                 AND DATE(f.order_ts_utc) <= fp.period_end_date
  WHERE f.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
  GROUP BY fp.fiscal_period
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fiscal_period,
    s.transaction_count + w.transaction_count AS total_transactions,
    s.total_sales + w.total_sales AS total_sales,
    (s.total_sales + w.total_sales) / (s.transaction_count + w.transaction_count) AS atv
  FROM store_sales s
  FULL OUTER JOIN web_sales w ON s.fiscal_period = w.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  total_transactions,
  total_sales,
  atv
FROM combined
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) AS min_sale_date,
  MAX(sale_date) AS max_sale_date,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipt_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'ST'

SELECT 
  MIN(DATE(order_ts_utc)) AS min_order_date,
  MAX(DATE(order_ts_utc)) AS max_order_date,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code = 'ST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS st_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code = 'WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel_code = 'ST' THEN receipt_id END) AS st_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS all_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  channel_code,
  channel_id,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  SUM(net_amount) AS total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY fiscal_period, channel_code, channel_id
ORDER BY fiscal_period, channel_code

SELECT

  channel_name,
  channel_group,
  legacy_channel_code
FROM dim_channel

SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.channel_id = 1 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS store_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.channel_id = 1 THEN f.receipt_id END) AS store_receipts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.channel_id IN (2, 3) THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.channel_id IN (2, 3) THEN f.receipt_id END) AS web_receipts,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS total_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
